content.content: The detail panel's three sections, kind, content and rationale, each collapse and expand independently. Every section starts expanded: a section shows its value until the user collapses it. Collapsing a section hides only that section's value; expanding it shows that value again. A user action on one section changes only that section: the other two sections keep the state they had, the three sections keep the order kind, content, rationale, and none is removed, so every selection shows the same frame whatever the collapse states are. A collapsed section keeps its label: the label stays visible while the value is hidden, each section stays identified by its field name, and the three labelled sections are present in every combination of collapse states. The detail body is no longer one collapsible block: no single action collapses or expands all three sections together, and a section is collapsed or expanded only through the action belonging to that section. This decision settles collapse granularity and nothing else. It does not settle how a section's value is rendered according to its content type, which further sections, if any, the panel presents beside these three, or whether a section's collapsed state carries over when a different node is selected.
content.rationale: vqwoptmu fixed the panel's frame as three labelled sections, kind then content then rationale, each present even when its value is empty, and explicitly left collapse behaviour to the decision that owns it; this node owns that behaviour and settles it at section granularity. Sections that collapse independently let a reader suppress a long content value while keeping the rationale, or hide the rationale while reading content, without leaving the frame; a single body-wide collapse cannot express that, because it offers only all-visible or all-hidden for three different intents. Removing the whole-body collapse leaves one collapse mechanism instead of two competing ones, so a collapsed panel is never ambiguous about whether it hides everything or one section. Collapse hides a value and never a label, which keeps vqwoptmu's requirement that a section be identified by its field name: a reader always sees which of the three fields a value belongs to, collapsed or not, and the order is untouched because collapsing moves and drops nothing. The commitment is licensed by the layout document's collapsible detail region, which describes that region at panel level; this decision refines the granularity of that collapsibility, and the layout document's wording is corrected by the change that owns it, not here. Nothing in this node rewrites the section frame, rules on how a value is rendered for its content type, or adds relationship sections, and it deliberately leaves the memory of collapsed state across selections open, because that is a separate commitment.
